grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and check your eligibility for Access to Work

grants.description: Share information about your disability, illness or health condition and how it affects your work
grants.purpose: To assess what support you need and determine your grant amount

grants.description: Share details of a workplace contact who can confirm you work there
grants.purpose: To verify your employment status and arrange workplace assessment if needed

grants.description: Give permission for Access to Work to contact your employer
grants.purpose: To discuss reasonable adjustments, arrange workplace assessment, and coordinate support provision

grants.description: Give permission for an assessor to view your workplace by video call or in person
grants.purpose: To determine what physical or equipment changes might help you in your role

grants.description: Share your Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) if you are self-employed
grants.purpose: To verify your self-employment status and confirm you meet the minimum turnover requirement

grants.description: Share bank account details for receiving grant payments or reimbursements
grants.purpose: To pay your approved Access to Work grant and reimburse approved expenses

grants.description: Share information about other benefits you receive, particularly ESA
grants.purpose: To ensure Access to Work does not affect your other benefits and you meet eligibility criteria

revocation.mechanism: Contact Access to Work helpline on 0800 121 7479 or email to revoke consent
revocation.effect: Application will be withdrawn if consent is revoked before decision. Grant may be withdrawn if consent is revoked after approval.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot provide medical advice or diagnosis. Agent cannot consent to employer contact on your behalf. Agent cannot consent to workplace assessment without your explicit permission. Agent cannot accept or reject a grant offer on your behalf. Agent cannot provide bank details without your confirmation. All sensitive health information requires your explicit review before submission.
